cards.title: Shifted B_s Encoding for Signed Ternary Sparse States
cards.statement: Let a_1,...,a_m be a B_s set modulo N with representatives in [0,N-1]. Set L=2s(N-1)+1 and w_i=L+a_i. Then x -> sum_i x_i w_i is injective on every x in {-1,0,1}^m with support at most s.
cards.proof_core: A collision first forces equal total charge because the residual magnitude is below L. Moving negative terms across gives equal-length sums of k terms, where k is half the total support of the two states and therefore k<=s. Pad to s terms and invoke B_s uniqueness. The resulting multiset equality is exactly equality of the signed coefficient vectors.
cards.novelty_boundary: The B_s input is classical. The exact signed charge-shift formulation was generated by composing the existing binary B_s and signed support-two assets; historical novelty has not been checked.

cards.title: Optimal Signed Ternary Sparse Exponent
cards.statement: For fixed s, the minimum possible largest positive integer weight that exactly encodes every {-1,0,1}-valued vector of support at most s is Theta_s(m^s).
cards.proof_core: There are sum_{r=0}^s 2^r binom(m,r)=Theta_s(m^s) states but only 2sW+1 possible sums with maximum weight W, giving Omega_s(m^s). SGN-04 plus a classical B_s construction in a cyclic group of order O_s(m^s) gives O_s(m^s).
cards.novelty_boundary: Likely related to signed/generalized Sidon sequence literature. The campaign has closed the theorem internally, but historical novelty is unverified.

cards.title: Signed Three-Sparse Theta(m^3) Closure
cards.statement: The optimal largest positive integer weight for encoding all {-1,0,1}-valued support-at-most-three vectors is Theta(m^3).
cards.novelty_boundary: Corollary of SGN-05; historical novelty follows the parent theorem's unresolved status.
